title: What is the surname of the driver with the best lap time in race number 19
question:
What is the surname of the driver with the best lap time in race number 19 in the second qualifying period?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: race number refers to raceId; second qualifying period refers to q2; best lap time refers to MIN(q2);

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT d.XCL_038
FROM qualifying q
JOIN drivers d ON q.XCL_058 = d.XCL_034
WHERE q.XCL_057 = 19
  AND q.XCL_060 = 2
ORDER BY q.XCL_062 ASC
LIMIT 1

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT d.XCL_035
FROM qualifying q
JOIN drivers d ON q.XCL_058 = d.XCL_034
WHERE q.XCL_057 = 19 AND q.XCL_063 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY q.XCL_063 ASC
LIMIT 1
